desc: Ideate approach: binary search over maximum run length with local DP feasibility check.

Implement feasible(L) with dp0/dp1 arrays of length L+1, initialize first character, transition same bit only if run_len < L and opposite bit resets run_len to 1, add flip cost when chosen bit differs from s[i], and prune costs above numOps.
Implement binary search over L in [1, original max run], with shortcuts for n == 1 / numOps == 0 / max run == 1, and return lo.
Add unit tests for examples and random small n brute-force over all final strings within numOps flips to validate exactness.
